wP}aH1@(s4nT-$0c?XDG.text:
Allies are spawned from spawn points in the world.  Use the same pattern as the 'Spawners' sprite:

- Create an "Ally Spawner" of a specific ally type
- Each Ally Spawner has a maximum spawn count (allies that are alive for that spawner)
- An ally will spawn only off screen so they don't pop
- An ally will spawn based off a timer until hitting the maximum count for that spawner

Ally AI
- Allies move for a specific period within a particular zone
- Allies will change direction after a certain amount of time
